criteria.requirement: Add BaseResponse.charset setter that validates a real codec before mutating Content-Type, replaces all case-insensitive/quoted charset parameters with one selected charset and preserves media type and unrelated parameters including quoted semicolons. Getter must read quoted/case-insensitive parameters correctly. Real Bottle string output must use the selected encoding; bytes behavior and direct content_type assignment remain unchanged. Invalid/empty codecs leave headers intact.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
